hunks.baseline: A Supreme Peak master was a being capable of feats straight out of an old folktale—erasing several zhang of distance in a single step, leaping through the air as though stepping on empty space, and bringing down a cliff with one punch.
hunks.sol: A Supreme Peak master could perform feats straight out of an old folktale—crossing several zhang in a single step, leaping through empty air as though it were solid ground, and bringing down a cliff with one punch.

hunks.baseline: “Hold on tight—aaahhh!”
hunks.sol: “Hold on ti—aaaaah!”

hunks.baseline: This place was the middle of the Yangtze, vast as an endless ocean rather than solid land.
hunks.sol: We were not on solid ground, but in the middle of the Yangtze, a river as vast as the open sea.

hunks.baseline: In front of a massive whirlpool hundreds of zhang across, the fast ship carrying me was no more than a tiny leaf.
hunks.sol: Before a massive whirlpool hundreds of zhang across, the swift ship carrying me was no more than a tiny leaf.

hunks.baseline: Boom!
hunks.sol: BOOM!

hunks.baseline: When the tremendous pressure of the water slammed into the side of the fast ship, the hull that had been moving swiftly and roughly lifted into the air and tilted sideways.
hunks.sol: The tremendous pressure of the water slammed into the swift ship’s side. The racing vessel was hurled into the air and began to tilt.

hunks.baseline: As the world slowly turned upside down, Jin Wikyung clung tightly to my upper body as if I were a life jacket and screamed.
hunks.sol: As the world slowly turned upside down, Jin Wikyung clung to my torso as though I were a life jacket and screamed.

hunks.baseline: *Fuck, there isn’t even an answer.*
hunks.sol: *What fucking answer? There isn’t one.*

hunks.baseline: But the bigger problem was that it wasn’t just Jin Wikyung. Gung Gibang, Hyuk Mujin, and even the disciples of the Zhuge Clan and Wudang had all been driven half out of their minds.
hunks.sol: But the bigger problem was that Jin Wikyung was not alone. Gung Gibang, Hyuk Mujin, and even the disciples of the Zhuge Clan and Wudang had all been driven half out of their minds.

hunks.baseline: Boom!
hunks.sol: BOOM!

hunks.baseline: Compressed air burst outward in a wave of powerful internal energy.
hunks.sol: Compressed air exploded outward on a wave of powerful internal energy.

hunks.baseline: Part of the whirlpool that had been raging like a blade dispersed, and the hull that had been plunging upside down toward the surface barely managed to regain its balance.
hunks.sol: Part of the blade-like whirlpool scattered, and the vessel, which had been plunging upside down toward the river, barely managed to right itself.

hunks.baseline: A second and then a third whirlpool were approaching the falling fast ship.
hunks.sol: A second and then a third whirlpool were bearing down on the falling swift ship.

hunks.baseline: *I’m not enough on my own. In a situation like this…*
hunks.sol: *I can’t do this alone. At a time like this…*

hunks.baseline: With a thought flashing through my mind like lightning, I shouted one person’s name.
hunks.sol: A thought flashed through my mind like lightning, and I shouted a single name.

hunks.baseline: Cheongpung nodded as if he understood everything and raised both arms.
hunks.sol: Cheongpung nodded as though he understood perfectly and flung both arms into the air.

hunks.baseline: “No, not ‘kiya-hoo,’ you lunatic! Do what I did!”
hunks.sol: “Not ‘kiya-hoo,’ you lunatic! Do what I did!”

hunks.baseline: Cheongpung had been enjoying the Wolmido Disco Pang Pang[^1] all by himself, but now he shook both sleeves.
hunks.sol: Cheongpung had been enjoying the Wolmido Disco Pang Pang[^1] all by himself, but now he snapped both sleeves.

hunks.baseline: The Taeeul Miri Palm, one of Huashan’s proudest techniques, transformed into dozens of flower petals that lashed out through the air.
hunks.sol: The Taeeul Miri Palm, one of Huashan’s proudest techniques, transformed into dozens of flower petals that lashed through the air.

hunks.baseline: Boom-boom-boom!
hunks.sol: BOOM-BOOM-BOOM!

hunks.baseline: It could not match the destructive power of the Flame Divine Palm, but in a situation like this, the Taeeul Miri Palm was perfect, thanks to its much wider range.
hunks.sol: It could not match the destructive power of the Flame Divine Palm, but in a situation like this, the Taeeul Miri Palm’s far wider range made it ideal.

hunks.baseline: When Tianling Falls, which had been raging like a blade, faltered, it seemed that the disciples of the Zhuge Clan and Wudang also regained the senses that had briefly departed them.
hunks.sol: When the blade-like currents of Tianling Falls faltered, the disciples of the Zhuge Clan and Wudang seemed to recover the senses that had briefly abandoned them.

hunks.baseline: “Ha-ha-ha! The tiger is rampaging! Disciples of our family, unleash the Great Heavenly Star Divine Palm!”
hunks.sol: “Ha-ha-ha! The tiger is running wild! Disciples of our family, unleash the Great Heavenly Star Divine Palm!”

hunks.baseline: Crouching Dragon Guest Zhuge Feng, who had issued the order, waved the feather fan in his hand.
hunks.sol: Crouching Dragon Guest Zhuge Feng issued the order as he swept the feather fan in his hand.

hunks.baseline: Although he had not yet crossed the wall, he was said to stand shoulder to shoulder with Supreme Peak masters when it came to fan techniques alone.
hunks.sol: Though he had yet to cross the wall into the Supreme Peak realm, his mastery of fan techniques alone was said to rival that of a Supreme Peak master.

hunks.baseline: Whoooosh!
hunks.sol: WHOOOOSH!

hunks.baseline: The breeze that began along the fan’s ribs transformed into a powerful wind and blocked the whirlpool.
hunks.sol: A breeze stirred along the fan’s ribs, then swelled into a mighty wind that held back the whirlpool.

hunks.baseline: And at the moment when a wall of water rose high like a triangular wave, seemingly ready to swallow the fast ship, only to be stopped by the wind—
hunks.sol: A towering surge rose like a triangular wave, threatening to swallow the swift ship, only to be stopped by the wind.
At that moment—

hunks.baseline: Whoosh!
hunks.sol: SWISH!

hunks.baseline: A streak of light shot up from the waist of Perfected Being Hyeongong and swept through the air.
hunks.sol: A streak of light shot from Perfected Being Hyeongong’s waist and swept through the air.

hunks.baseline: The streak of light passed through everything in its path, cleaving space and slicing through the wind. The wall of water raised by Tianling Falls seemed to be severed in an instant before collapsing into pieces.
hunks.sol: The streak of light flashed through everything in its path, cleaving space and slicing through the wind. The wall of water raised by Tianling Falls seemed to split apart for an instant, then shattered completely.

hunks.baseline: Spray scattered in every direction.
hunks.sol: Spray burst in every direction.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang, who had been drenched by an enormous amount of cold water, opened his eyes wide like a man waking from sleep.
hunks.sol: Drenched in an enormous volume of cold water, Jeok Cheongang’s eyes flew open like a man waking from sleep.

hunks.baseline: Then he glared at the whirlpool with eyes that poured flames and shouted.
hunks.sol: Then he glared at the whirlpool, flames streaming from his eyes, and roared.

hunks.baseline: It wasn’t entirely wrong, but why did he sound so pathetic?
hunks.sol: He wasn’t exactly wrong, but why did he sound so pathetic?

hunks.baseline: Contrary to my thoughts, however, the internal energy erupting from Jeok Cheongang’s sleeves was anything but pathetic.
hunks.sol: Contrary to that pathetic outburst, however, the internal energy erupting from Jeok Cheongang’s sleeves was overwhelmingly powerful.

hunks.baseline: Fwoosh—KRA-KOOOOM!
hunks.sol: FWOOOSH—KRA-KOOOOM!

hunks.baseline: Several jiazi’s worth of Scorching Yang Qi burst out all at once.
hunks.sol: Several jiazi of Scorching Yang Qi burst forth at once.

hunks.baseline: The moisture filling the air evaporated, and the fast ship shot forward like an arrow under the tremendous recoil.
hunks.sol: The moisture filling the air evaporated, and the tremendous recoil sent the swift ship shooting forward like an arrow.

hunks.baseline: Boom-boom-boom!
hunks.sol: BOOM-BOOM-BOOM!

hunks.baseline: Palm forces erupted without pause to protect the ship, while Tianling Falls tried to sink the unwelcome guests who had entered its territory without permission.
hunks.sol: Palm forces erupted without pause as we fought to protect the vessel, while Tianling Falls sought to sink the uninvited guests who had trespassed upon its domain.

hunks.baseline: Mu Song gritted his teeth so hard that blood began to seep from his gums, the veins standing out on his neck.
hunks.sol: Mu Song gritted his teeth hard enough to draw blood, the veins bulging in his neck.

hunks.baseline: “Hard to port! Turn at the same time!”
hunks.sol: “Hard to port! Turn together!”

hunks.baseline: Bang!
hunks.sol: BANG!

hunks.baseline: In the middle of this chaotic situation, only three people knew the secret of how the young medical apprentice had quietly fired a palm force while screaming strategically among the others: Jeok Cheongang, Cheongpung, and me.
hunks.sol: Amid the chaos, the young medical apprentice blended in by screaming with everyone else while secretly firing off a palm force. Only Jeok Cheongang, Cheongpung, and I knew what he had done.

hunks.baseline: “Now! Row with every bit of strength you have!”
hunks.sol: “Now! Row with every last bit of strength you have!”

hunks.baseline: Hard work never betrayed its results.
hunks.sol: Their efforts paid off.

hunks.baseline: And so, the four fast ships carrying hundreds of passengers pushed onward through the whirlpool, farther and farther ahead.
hunks.sol: The four swift ships carrying hundreds of passengers drove onward through the whirlpools, farther and farther ahead.

hunks.baseline: The moment they passed through Tianling Falls, the exhausted passengers collapsed wherever they stood, no longer bothering with appearances.
hunks.sol: The moment we cleared Tianling Falls, the exhausted passengers sprawled across the decks without the slightest concern for appearances.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang gazed at the Yangtze, which had become unbelievably calm, his eyes red around the edges. Then he suddenly opened his mouth.
hunks.sol: His eyes red around the edges, Jeok Cheongang stared at the waters of the Yangtze, now calm as though nothing had happened. Then he abruptly spoke.

hunks.baseline: “As the current Sect Leader of the Fire Gate Clan, I hereby declare that, as of this time tomorrow, the Zhuge Clan shall be our public enemy.”
hunks.sol: “As the current Sect Leader of the Fire Gate Clan, I hereby declare that, as of this time tomorrow, the Zhuge Clan shall be our sect’s public enemy.”

hunks.baseline: “Every bastard bearing the Zhuge name should be seized and thrown into that godforsaken Tianling Falls. Any objections?”
hunks.sol: “Every bastard bearing the Zhuge name will be seized and thrown into that godforsaken Tianling Falls. Any objections?”

hunks.baseline: “What if there are?”
hunks.sol: “What if I have one?”

hunks.baseline: “Then I’ll have no objection.”
hunks.sol: “Then I have no objections.”

hunks.baseline: “Good. Seize that goddamn bastard and bring him before me at once.”
hunks.sol: “Good. Seize that goddamn bastard at once and bring him before me.”

hunks.baseline: At the end of Jeok Cheongang’s burning gaze was a fast ship following several dozen zhang behind us, with Zhuge Feng sitting at its bow and waving his feather fan.
hunks.sol: At the end of Jeok Cheongang’s blazing gaze was a swift ship following several dozen zhang behind us. Zhuge Feng sat at its bow, waving his feather fan.

hunks.baseline: “Are you laughing?”
hunks.sol: “…Are you laughing?”

hunks.baseline: It was easier to bring down a cliff than to escape after being sucked into a whirlpool in the middle of the vast Yangtze, where there was nowhere to run.
hunks.sol: Bringing down a cliff would have been easier than escaping a whirlpool in the middle of the vast Yangtze, with nowhere to flee.

hunks.baseline: People tossed around names like Stepping on Empty Air and Rising on Duckweed, Crossing Water as if they were simple tricks, but those techniques consumed tremendous amounts of internal energy. Rescuing several hundred people was beyond the realm of possibility.
hunks.sol: People tossed around names like Stepping on Empty Air and Rising on Duckweed, Crossing Water as though they were simple tricks, but both techniques consumed tremendous amounts of internal energy. Rescuing several hundred people would have been unthinkable.

hunks.baseline: *What the hell is something like that doing in a river, not even the sea?*
hunks.sol: *What the hell is something like that doing in a river? It isn’t even the sea.*

hunks.baseline: There was a reason it had been given the name Tianling Falls.
hunks.sol: There was a reason it was called Tianling Falls.

hunks.baseline: Then again, if it were merely a somewhat fierce current, the Zhuge Clan and Wudang would have stormed into Donghu Stronghold long ago.
hunks.sol: Then again, if it had merely been a rough stretch of water, the Zhuge Clan and Wudang would have stormed Donghu Stronghold long ago.

hunks.baseline: And while I was thinking about this, Jeok Cheongang’s anger continued racing toward its conclusion.
hunks.sol: Even as I thought this, Jeok Cheongang’s fury continued racing toward its peak.

hunks.baseline: “Turn the ship around at once. Whether he calls himself Zhuge Feng or Crouching Dragon Guest, this old man will break that bastard’s legs and make him lie down for the rest of his life!”
hunks.sol: “Turn the ship around at once! Zhuge Feng, Crouching Dragon Guest—whatever that bastard calls himself, this old man will break both his legs today and leave him bedridden for the rest of his life!”

hunks.baseline: “Please calm down. Calm down.”
hunks.sol: “Calm down. Please calm down.”

hunks.baseline: “Do I look like I can calm down right now? I already hate water, and now I’ve suffered through this because we came to some godforsaken place! And the man who claims to have crossed it several times is groaning because he can’t even find the correct waterway! At this point, are you a river bandit or a ferryman on the road to the underworld?”
hunks.sol: “Do I look like I can calm down right now? I already hate water, and now I’ve suffered through this because we came to some godforsaken place! The man who claims to have crossed it several times can’t even find the right channel and just stands there groaning! At this point, are you a river bandit or a ferryman to the afterlife?”

hunks.baseline: At the sight of Jeok Cheongang raging like a madman, Mu Song, who had been lying spread-eagled on the deck, flinched and forced himself upright.
hunks.sol: At the sight of Jeok Cheongang raging like a madman, Mu Song, who had been lying spread-eagled on the deck, flinched and pushed himself upright.

hunks.baseline: “You’ve been here several times and didn’t know? If you don’t know, does your life as a river bandit end here? Should I end your life here, too?”
hunks.sol: “You’ve crossed it several times and didn’t know? Does not knowing mean you get to quit being a river bandit? Should I end your life here too?”

hunks.baseline: “That’s not it. The current at Tianling Falls has grown abnormally strong compared to before…”
hunks.sol: “T-that’s not it. The currents of Tianling Falls have grown abnormally strong compared to before…”

hunks.baseline: “Grown stronger? What kind of bullshit is that? It barely rained this year, and you’re trying to deceive this old man with sweet talk that’ll be exposed immediately?”
hunks.sol: “Grown stronger? What kind of bullshit is that? It has barely rained this year, and you dare try to deceive this old man with sweet talk that will be exposed at once?”

hunks.baseline: The day you were caught lying to him, losing a hand would be the least of your worries. Your entire body would be roasted medium-rare.
hunks.sol: If he caught you lying, losing a hand would be the least of your worries. Your whole body would end up roasted medium-rare.

hunks.baseline: *By the way, can the current really become that strong when there hasn’t been much rain?*
hunks.sol: *Still, can the current really get that much stronger when there hasn’t been much rain?*

hunks.baseline: Never mind. I wasn’t a meteorologist or an ecosystem researcher. Thinking about it wouldn’t produce an answer.
hunks.sol: Forget it. I wasn’t a meteorologist or an ecosystem researcher. Thinking about it would get me nowhere.

hunks.baseline: I clicked my tongue softly and spoke to Jeok Cheongang, who had not stopped berating Mu Song.
hunks.sol: I clicked my tongue softly and addressed Jeok Cheongang, who had not stopped berating Mu Song.

hunks.baseline: “When we return, do your job properly. If you make this old man suffer through what we just experienced one more time, I’ll storm the headquarters of the Yangtze River Channel League, set every ship on fire, and throw that Seafaring King bastard into Tianling Falls along with the Zhuge Clan bastards…”
hunks.sol: “When we return, do your job properly. If you make this old man suffer through something like that again, I’ll storm the headquarters of the Yangtze River Channel League, burn every ship to ashes, and throw that Seafaring King bastard into Tianling Falls along with the Zhuge Clan bastards…”

hunks.baseline: Tap-tap-tap-tap!
hunks.sol: TATATAT!

hunks.baseline: He moved with the speed of lightning itself.
hunks.sol: He moved like a flash of lightning.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang tossed Mu Song aside and crossed the fast ship in a single step, then stared ahead with his eyes wide open.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang flung Mu Song aside, crossed the swift ship in a single step, and stared straight ahead with his eyes wide open.

hunks.baseline: Soon, an emotional exclamation spilled from his lips.
hunks.sol: An awed exclamation soon escaped his lips.

hunks.baseline: Anyone watching him might have thought he had discovered a treasure island, but what appeared beyond the thick fog was simply an island.
hunks.sol: Anyone watching him might have thought he had discovered a treasure island, but what emerged beyond the thick fog was an ordinary island.

hunks.baseline: It was not small like the islands scattered along Korea’s Han River, nor was it an uninhabited island with no sign of human presence.
hunks.sol: It was neither small like the islands scattered along Korea’s Han River nor deserted, without any sign of human habitation.

hunks.baseline: “That thing over there… Could it be…”
hunks.sol: “That over there… Could it be…?”

hunks.baseline: At Hyuk Mujin’s mutter, Gung Gibang, standing beside him, nodded.
hunks.sol: At Hyuk Mujin’s murmur, Gung Gibang nodded beside him.

hunks.baseline: “It’s a ferry landing. Looks like we came to the right place.”
hunks.sol: “It’s a landing. Looks like we came to the right place.”

hunks.baseline: The existence of a ferry landing where ships could dock meant, in other words, that people lived there—or that the island was frequently used as a stopover.
hunks.sol: A landing where ships could dock meant that people either lived there or frequently used the island as a stopover.

hunks.baseline: And everyone present already knew the identity of those who had established a settlement in a place that could only be reached after crossing that insane Tianling Falls.
hunks.sol: And everyone present already knew who had established their home in a place that could only be reached by crossing that insane Tianling Falls.

hunks.baseline: “Whoa, Donghu Stronghold!”
hunks.sol: “Wow, Donghu Stronghold!”

hunks.baseline: Cheongpung’s shout shattered the silence of the Yangtze and spread into the distance.
hunks.sol: Cheongpung’s shout broke the silence of the Yangtze and rang out across the water.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung opened his mouth, his face stiff.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung spoke, his expression stiff.

hunks.baseline: “By now, Donghu Stronghold must know that we have arrived. It would be wise to prepare for any unforeseen situation.”
hunks.sol: “By now, Donghu Stronghold must know we have arrived. It would be wise to prepare for any unforeseen developments.”

hunks.baseline: No one needed to ask what that unforeseen situation meant.
hunks.sol: No one needed to ask what he meant.

hunks.baseline: If Donghu Stronghold really was responsible for the two incidents that had occurred over the past fifteen days, just as the circumstances revealed so far suggested… then a clash of martial force might take place, in accordance with the laws of Murim.
hunks.sol: If Donghu Stronghold was indeed responsible for the two incidents that had occurred over the past fortnight, as all the evidence so far suggested… then, by the laws of Murim, an armed clash might be unavoidable.

hunks.baseline: Mu Song, who had remained silent with his mouth shut, stared at Jin Wikyung as he answered.
hunks.sol: Mu Song had remained silent until now. He met Jin Wikyung’s gaze and answered.

hunks.baseline: “The reason my subordinates and I came here at the head of the group was to prove that the brothers of our League are innocent. If you persecute us without even hearing the full circumstances…”
hunks.sol: “My subordinates and I took the lead in coming here to prove our League brothers’ innocence. If you persecute us without even hearing the full circumstances…”

hunks.baseline: “I can state categorically that such a thing will not happen. Wudang and the Zhuge Clan have already vouched for this, and everyone present, myself included, will serve as witnesses.”
hunks.sol: “I can promise you that will not happen. Wudang and the Zhuge Clan have already guaranteed as much, and everyone present, myself included, will serve as a witness.”

hunks.baseline: Mu Song hesitated before giving a small nod.
hunks.sol: After a brief hesitation, Mu Song gave a small nod.

hunks.baseline: “…I’ll believe you.”
hunks.sol: “…I will trust you.”

hunks.baseline: Perhaps Mu Song was the person here who most wanted to prevent bloodshed.
hunks.sol: Perhaps Mu Song was the person here most desperate to prevent bloodshed.

hunks.baseline: No matter how outstanding the river bandits of Donghu Stronghold were, and no matter how powerful Yangtze One Saber Hwang Chung—the man who led them—might be as a Supreme Peak master, they could not withstand our current strength.
hunks.sol: No matter how skilled the river bandits of Donghu Stronghold might be, and no matter how powerful their leader, Yangtze One Saber Hwang Chung, was as a Supreme Peak master, they could not withstand our current force.

hunks.baseline: Even if some utterly incomprehensible disaster—a true one-in-ten-thousand chance—caused everyone here to sink into the Yangtze, the Yangtze River Channel League would then have to face all of Murim.
hunks.sol: Even if some utterly incomprehensible disaster—a genuine one-in-ten-thousand chance—sent everyone here to the bottom of the Yangtze, the Yangtze River Channel League would then have to face the whole of Murim. If the Nine Sects and One Gang joined forces with the Five Great Families, the League would vanish without a trace.

hunks.baseline: If the Nine Sects and One Gang joined forces with the Five Great Families, the Yangtze River Channel League would disappear without a trace.

hunks.baseline: Soon, the Yangtze River Channel League’s flag fluttered above the four fast ships, and seven low drumbeats echoed beyond the fog.
hunks.sol: Soon, the flag of the Yangtze River Channel League fluttered above the four swift ships, and seven low drumbeats echoed beyond the fog.

hunks.baseline: The Yangtze, the fog, and the quietly flowing river remained unchanged.
hunks.sol: The Yangtze, the fog, and the quietly flowing water remained unchanged.

hunks.baseline: The only things that changed were the puzzled expression on Jin Wikyung’s face and Mu Song’s wavering eyes.
hunks.sol: The only things that changed were the question on Jin Wikyung’s face and the unease in Mu Song’s eyes.

hunks.baseline: “I’m not sure, either. We definitely sent the signal, so a reply should have come…”
hunks.sol: “I’m not sure. We definitely sent the signal, so a reply should have come…”

hunks.baseline: At the sudden voice, everyone turned their heads.
hunks.sol: Everyone turned toward the sudden voice.

hunks.baseline: Countless gazes fell on the young medical apprentice whom no one had paid attention to until now.
hunks.sol: Countless gazes fell upon the young medical apprentice whom no one had paid any attention to until now.

hunks.baseline: In a clear, composed voice, he continued.
hunks.sol: He continued in a clear, composed voice.

hunks.baseline: “What do you mean…!”
hunks.sol: “What do you mean…?”

hunks.baseline: Mu Song’s shout never finished.
hunks.sol: Mu Song’s shout died unfinished.

hunks.baseline: There, something previously hidden by the fog and aquatic plants had floated into view.
hunks.sol: Something previously concealed by the fog and aquatic plants had floated into view.
